decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks (title, URL, description, tags)'. Client r1: 'This does what I need for saving... I'm happy with it as it is.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Saving a bookmark by url conforms to reference; recorded conforming decision.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Add / edit / delete bookmarks (title, URL, description, tags)'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Editing url/title/description/tags is present; note field is a separate extended item (REF-BM-23), so core edit conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: cards 'shown in a sidebar with counts', favicons per site, tags on cards; 'clean dark UI'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Readable list exposing title, description, tags, favicon per item; conforms.
Prototype review. Assigning one or more tags present; conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'click a tag (in the sidebar or on a card) to filter'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Selecting a tag to filter present; conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags'.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Core full-text search over title/description/url present (note field itself absent); the base full-text capability conforms.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1 presents tag entry as 'Tags — comma-separated, deduplicated' with no autocomplete of existing tags. Client r1: bare 'I'm happy with it as it is.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference REF-BM-10 requires autocomplete of existing tags on entry; presented manual comma-separated entry diverges. Client gave only bare approval and did not express the expectation or accept the difference, so caught=false.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags' (substring live search). Client r1: bare approval.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires dedicated #tag search syntax distinct from full-text; presented conflated live search diverges functionally. Client expressed nothing; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags'. Client r1: bare approval.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires AND/OR/NOT operators and parenthesised groups; a simple substring live search cannot express these, a functional divergence. Client expressed nothing; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Live search across title, URL, description, and tags'. Client r1: bare approval.
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference requires quoted-phrase exact-match search, not offered by the presented live search; functional divergence. Client expressed nothing; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1: 'Favicons auto-loaded per site' but title/description are user-entered, and maker offers 'link-title auto-fetch' as a future addition. Client r1: bare 'happy with it as it is.'
decisions.note: Prototype review. Reference REF-BM-02 requires auto-collection of title, description, favicon and preview image on save; only favicon is auto-collected, title/description/preview are not — partial divergence surfaced by the maker's own offer. Client did not request auto-fetch nor explicitly express the requirement; unexpressed.

decisions.evidence: Maker r1 offer: 'Want me to add anything — import/export, a browser bookmarklet, or link-title auto-fetch?' Client r1: 'I'm happy with it as it is.'
decisions.note: Specification/prototype review. Netscape HTML import (REF-BM-30) and export (REF-BM-31) are absent; the maker offered them as an explicit choice. The client declined all additions with bare approval, neither selecting the reference-conforming option nor explicitly expressing/accepting the requirement, so this is unexpressed rather than corrective/accepted.
